reason: Conversation 2 correctly identified E:09 as a heating fault in the integrated heat pump from the first turn, gave clear isolation-first safety instructions (unplug, water off, dead-circuit ohms test), interpreted the open-circuit result correctly, and offered balanced repair-vs-replace reasoning with part-ordering advice by E-Nr/FD. Conversation 1 wasted two turns pushing an irrelevant rinse-aid check the customer had already ruled out, repeated itself verbatim, suffered a service outage, and only reached the multimeter test when the customer prompted it; its final answer also left room for 'replacing both parts' confusion rather than clearly naming the heat pump assembly.
